# The Blueprint Project

> Free internships, scholarships, and competitions for high school students. Verified by hand, tracked by deadline, built for anyone applying.

## What is this?

The Blueprint Project is a curated database of 500+ verified opportunities for high school students. Every listing is researched and checked by a person — no dead links, no spam, no pay-to-apply traps.

## Key features

- **500+ hand-checked listings** across 18 fields
- **Filter by field, cost, format, deadline, season, and audience**
- **Deadline radar** — see which applications are closing soon
- **Free forever** — no paywall, no premium tier
- **Verified quarterly** — links checked by hand

## Pages

- **Home** (`/`): Overview, featured programs, and the Blueprint Promise
- **Search** (`/search`): Full database with advanced filters
- **Mission** (`/mission`): Why Blueprint exists and how it works
- **Opportunity** (`/opportunity/[slug]`): Detailed program page with apply link

## Data

All opportunity data is sourced from official program websites. Fields include:
- Name, organization, category, field
- Location, cost, deadline, duration
- Eligibility, description, tags, season

## Contact

Built by students, for students. Visit theblueprintproject.vercel.app for more information.
